environment.description: AWS Lambda function invoked directly by Step Functions state machine with API Gateway HTTP API (v2) integration. The API Gateway has no request validation or URI encoding restrictions. The Lambda execution role has s3:GetObject on arn:aws:s3:::corp-documents-prod/* (wildcard). No CloudFront distribution in front; API Gateway endpoint is publicly accessible. Step Functions workflow accepts arbitrary path input from EventBridge rules triggered by user-submitted events.

config.api_gateway: HTTP API v2, no request validation
config.network: public API Gateway endpoint, no CloudFront
config.s3_bucket_policy: allows GetObject from Lambda role on all keys
